prompt: We're running the virtual waiting room for a flash sale: up to a million visitors get enqueued into a single Redis sorted set, and every waiting client polls a `getQueuePosition(token)` endpoint every few seconds to check how far along they are. Here is the current implementation of that lookup — under real flash-sale traffic it's saturating both Redis CPU and network, even though the actual business logic is trivial. Walk me through why this doesn't scale, and then optimize it.
